From the counter

Photos from guests in the café's Google listing.

The café behind the coffee bike

Name and logo come from a coffee bike, established in 2018, and the bike with its canopy stands inside the café today. The café is on two floors at the edge of the old town: plants hanging from the ceiling, velvet chairs, prints about coffee on the walls and a few tables outside. On Google, guests write about the choice of beans for espresso and filter, the espresso tonic and cold brew, the homemade cakes such as carrot cake and banana chocolate bread, and a calm atmosphere with good music. Many call it the best coffee in Larnaca.

Monday to Thursday 07:30 to 14:00, Friday from 07:30, Saturday 08:30 to 14:00, closed on Sundays. Coffee to go or to stay.

What guests say

Four of 278 Google reviews, 4.7 stars on average.

“I had a great experience at this café. The coffee was excellent. What really stood out were the pastries: the portions were huge and absolutely delicious. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, and the staff was very friendly.”
Google review
“This is a must-visit on the Larnaca coffee scene - we had an amazing Iced Flat White on our visit and some amazing truffle balls. The owner has a real handle on his craft as he used quality roasted beans and was so friendly during our visit, as well as having a beautifully designed interior and lovely outside seating area too.”
